input.reason: The claim holds. GetRecord caches every error from c.get for errorCacheTTL (5 minutes) without checking what kind of error it is. fetchFromServer does tell the two kinds apart: it uses isErrorReply to decide whether to reconnect. But a failed connect() (for example while the server restarts), a request timing out after 1s (context.DeadlineExceeded), or a network error that comes back on the retry is cached exactly like a permanent FORBIDDEN reply. loadMetadata now discards the error, so for up to 5 minutes, even after the server has recovered, every item for that key is tracked without Owner or Version, and nothing surfaces the problem except the one log line written when the error was first cached. This is wrong behavior introduced by the PR, but it is temporary and only drops extra metadata; the item is still tracked and IsSystem still works from the key.
